text: Dust is a type of magical element needed in Enchanting recipes and can be created by disenchanting magical items. Other types can be found as quest items, or like the death knight reagent Corpse Dust.

The Dwarven District lies in the northern corner of Stormwind City. Here, the dwarves of Ironforge established an enclave after the Second War to house all the workers sent by King Magni. The forges in the district produce a constant haze, supplemented by the constant strokes of smiths' hammers. Hunters will find a place to stay within the Hunter's Guild, located in this area. Profession trainers for mining, blacksmithing, and engineering, and corresponding forges and anvils can also be found here. The Stormwind City end of the Deeprun Tram line is accessible through a tunnel on the east side of the district. The changes made for Cataclysm to the district is stated to actually be a new const

Dwarven Farmers are dwarves located in the flat, isolated region of the Arathi Highlands that can be seen east of the eastern mountain range, and in the farm found in the southern Wetlands, reachable from the Dun Morogh airfield. For some reason, the farmers give out the same kind of information as Ironforge Mountaineers do, as if they were located in Dun Morogh. Although hostile to the Horde, they do not engage to attack but can be attacked by the player if PvP is enabled. With patch 7.3.5 introducing Zone scaling, these dwarves were unaffected.

Duyash the Cruel was an elite level 85 Eye of the Storm battlemaster located at Farstriders' Square in the blood elven capital of Silvermoon City during the Call to Arms: Eye of the Storm. He was only available during the monthly (Call to Arms: Eye of the Storm).

Dustquill Ravine is, much like Razorthorn Trail to the southeast across the mountains, a hillside and a pass covered with enormous brambles and inhabited by vicious ravagers. It is located just southwest of Falcon Watch and can be identified on the map by the brambles along the mountainside between the Ruins of Sha'naar and the Den of Haal'esh. The abandoned camp of the Wounded Blood Elf Pilgrim is located here.
Dustflight the Cowardly is a rare tallstrider located just off the road in the hills northwest of Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains.

Dust of Life is a pet ability available exclusively to the moth family of hunter pets, reviving a fallen party member with 60% health and 20% mana, even in combat. It is functionally identical to the quilen family's Eternal Guardian and the crane family's Gift of Chi-Ji. Note, however, that none of these abilities are usable in Arena matches.
__NOTOC__ The Duskwatch Moonmages are nightborne found in Artisan's Gallery of Suramar City in Suramar.
__NOTOC__ Duskwatch Guards are nightborne located in the Moonlit Landing and Gilded Market in the Court of Stars. Some are accompanied by Mana Sabers.
__NOTOC__ Duskwatch Moonscythes are nightborne located in Suramar City.
The Dusty Tomb is an Amathet tol'vir tomb accessed through the Swirling Sands portals found on islands on Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Duskwing Flutterersare small moths located on Duskfall Island in Talador. They typically fly in groups.

a type of eagle on the Dragon Isles.]] Eagles are Birds of Prey, found mainly in mountainous areas throughout Azeroth. The eagle is a national emblem for both the human nations of Alterac (a single-headed version) and Lordaeron (both a single and a mythical twin-headed version). The Amani tribe of forest trolls also worships an eagle loa named Akil'zon. Giant eagles are used as mounts by Frostborn and Highmountain tauren. Harpies create vile rocs from cursed eagles.

Earthbreaker Haromm was a shaman trainer located in Stonard of Swamp of Sorrows. He was also the only Horde shaman trainer in the Eastern Kingdoms before Mahala Cloudsong was added in the Undercity. At the time of the Darkspear Rebellion, he moved in the Valley of Strength, where he only taught dark shaman, while Mok replaced him in Stonard.
Earth magic is a form of magic. Kobolds are capable of it. Uthek the Wise used it to bring destruction to the Magram clan.
Earth Powered is one of the four buffs necessary to earn the feat of strength .

__NOTOC__ Dyrhara is a Highborne night elf mage trainer located near the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She is seen talking to Maelir. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she was maintaining the portal to Stormwind City in the Temple. It is not known whether she ultimately left it and survived or not.

Dylan Aguilar is a human child that can be found playing with her pet Otto von Chubbs in the Stormwind City Outskirts, near a house at the southwest of the island with the portals. She's hostile to Horde players, although she obviously can't be attacked.
The Dyvari Overgrowth is a region of controlled by the Blademoon botani. Many Primals reside in the overgrowth. The Blademoon Bloom is located within this region.

Eagle Cages could be found in Theramore Isle during the invasion of Durotar. Rexxar destroyed them and released the hawks they contained. The birds of prey then helped him navigate the city with their keen senses.

Two Earthen Ring Wavebinders, a Broken and a tauren, can be found at the Silver Tide Hollow in the Shimmering Expanse of Vashj'ir. They appear to be empowering a water elemental by channeling frost magic into it.
Earthstrike is a trinket that increases melee and ranged attack power for a limited time. This is the physical version of the Talisman of Ephemeral Power.
The Earthshatter Headpiece is a quest reward from Earthshatter Headpiece (quest).

Earthshatter Spaulders can be found listed on the Black Market Auction House by Quincy Cutler, for the opening bid of . It was once a quest reward from Earthshatter Spaulders (quest), before the introduction of the draenei and Alliance shamans.
The Earthshatter Tunic is a quest reward from Earthshatter Tunic (quest).
Earthshatter Wristguards originally was obtained through the quest Earthshatter Wristguards (quest).
The Earthshatter Handguards are a quest reward from Earthshatter Handguards (quest).

Eastwall Tower is a scout tower located in the Eastern Plaguelands. During the Scourge invasion of Lordaeron, Eastwall Tower was destroyed and left in ruins. Later it became a battleground as it was one of the fallen towers that the Alliance and Horde fought over for in order to fortify themselves in Lordaeron. The Eastwall Tower, along with all the other towers of the Eastern Plaguelands, have been rebuilt by the Argent Crusade and are currently being used as outposts throughout the region. Like the nearby Light's Hope Chapel, there are signs of life around the tower, and there is also a neutral flight master. The PvP component has been removed.
Earthshatter Boots are a quest reward from Earthshatter Boots (quest). It can only be listed on the Black Market Auction House by Quincy Cutler, for the opening bid of .
The Ebon Gryphon can be purchased for from the following vendors: * in Hellfire Peninsula * in Shadowmoon Valley * in Borean Tundra * in Dalaran * in Stormwind City
Earthmender Splinthoof is a tauren found in Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley.

The East Garrison is one of two garrisons that overlook the Dark Iron Highway inside Blackrock Depths. The garrisons guard the approach to two giant doors at the entrance to Shadowforge City. When closed, these doors would block an invading army coming up the highway and entering the city. Passages built inside the doors would allow defenders to cross the road between the two garrisons and fire down at the invaders from openings. When players first enter the instance, the eastern door is locked in the open position. That position allows players to reach the Black Anvil and Lord Incendius via the highway, but prevents them reaching the West Garrison, the Manufactory and the Grim Guzzler in th

Ebonfang is a manasaber companion of Delandros Shimmermoon found in Val'sharah. He has a strong sense of smell. Ebonfang rode the druid adventurer from Ashamane's Fall to Falanaar in Suramar in order to find Verstok Darkbough. Afterward, he rode the hero from the Shattered Locus to the Dreamgrove.
Earthshatter Elementals are earth elementals located on Dragonskull Island in the Forbidden Reach. They are also found at the Crumbling Cliffs in the Waking Shores.

The Ebon Scales are a dracthyr weyrn that were originally charged with bringing destruction to the enemies of the black dragonflight, raining down fire and unleashing spellcraft upon those who would stand against the Earth-Warder. After awakening from their confinement like the rest of the dracthyr, they felt betrayed by their former Aspect and decided to cut off ties with the dragonflights, departing and renaming themselves the Sundered Flame. Led by Scalecommander Sarkareth, the Flame went on a quest to reclaim their legacy and obtain the secrets of Neltharion for themselves, entering into open conflict with the inhabitants of the Dragon Isles or anyone who would stand in their way, includ
Edward Remington is a Forsaken tabard designer located in the Trade Quarter in Undercity. He was present during the Battle for Lordaeron and could be evacuated out of the Undercity.

Eco-domes are domes of arcane energy that, much like a greenhouse, provide an environment in which lush plants and animals can survive. The eco-domes contain the last of Netherstorm's greenery, carefully cultivated by the ethereals. These structures of channeled energy can currently be found in the central and northern parts of Netherstorm. The remainder of Netherstorm has been rendered hostile to most forms of life by demon invasion, the sundering of the world, or the effects of the manaforges. The ethereals built the domes and are currently maintaining them. The energy that powers these domes is magical, though the techniques for maintaining them have technological aspects. Some of the cre

Echo of Life is a belief system by some Forsaken that an echo of their former lives still exists in their undead state, and they try to gain access to it through the use of the arcane. Some Forsaken can't get over the fact that they are, for all intents and purposes, dead. Some accept the fact without issue. Both of these reactions can lead to arcane use, as the Forsaken seek to hear the echo of life. Forsaken who can't bear their undead condition feel more alive when wielding arcane power. The surge of power, so addictive to living creatures, proves just as intoxicating to the undead. Some scholars theorize that this addiction is purely psychological; others claim that a Forsaken's unique p

The Eclipsion is a group of powerful blood elves, loyal to Illidan Stormrage, who are located in southern Shadowmoon Valley. They are led by Grand Commander Ruusk and their champion is the one they call Ruul the Darkener. They also employ Eclipsion Dragonhawks and Eclipsion Hawkstriders.

Eclipse is a row 1 Balance druid talent. Eclipse consists of two buff effects. The talent is heavily interlinked with a pair of their casted spells, Wrath and Starfire. Casting the same spell twice grants an Eclipse effect. It empowers any casts of the opposite paired spell for a short duration, as well as the spell damage type for the empowered spell.
Echo of First Arcanist Thalyssra is a projection of Thalyssra briefly appearing in Dalaran and Suramar during Magic Message.
Eclipse-Caller is a moonkin located in Verdant Wilds during Island Expeditions.

Echoing Reprimand is the rogue class ability of the Kyrian Covenant. It's available to all rogues who join the Kyrian. This ability is also temporarily available during the Bastion portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Archon's Answer and lasts until you finish the Bastion storyline.

Elder Rise is directly east of the central bluff and is the home of the Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff. Many tauren druids and priests reside here and provide training. The Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem resides here. Before her exile, the leader of the Grimtotem tribe, Magatha Grimtotem, used to inhabit the hut between the two bridges. Elder Rise connects to high rise and middle rise by separate rope bridges. Elder Rise holds the governing Council of Elders and also members of the Cenarion Circle. During Saurfang's rebellion, Elder Rise was defended by Highmountain tauren led by Mayla Highmountain as well as Huojin and Tushui pandaren led by Ji Firepaw and Aysa Cloudsinger respectively. Afte
Eiin is a Broken tailoring vendor located at the Lower City market of the neutral Shattrath City.

__NOTOC__ .]] El Pollo Grande, the Black Chicken of Death, is a huge black chicken accidentally summoned by Niby the Almighty in Felwood upon completion of Kroshius' Infernal Core (quest). Niby actually intended to use Kroshius' Infernal Core to summon an infernal destroyer that he could use to exact his vengeance upon Stormwind City, but inadvertently summoned a giant chicken instead, much to Impsy's amusement. However, Niby promptly declared that

__NOTOC__ Elara is a blood elf rogue trainer located in the Students of Shadow in the Murder Row in Silvermoon City. She was present in the Court of the Sun during the closing of the remembrance ceremony.
El'dranil Peak is a mountain found in Azsuna. Without flight, the top can be accessed through a cave in the Greenway.
Eight of Air is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Dance. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Dance trinket.
Eight of Earth is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Watcher. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Watcher trinket.
Eight of Frost is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Rime. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Rime trinket.
Eight of Fire is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Inferno. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Inferno trinket.

Elemental Earth is a fundamental building block of the world. It embodies the virtues of strength and protection. Because of these qualities, it is sought after by crafters to create powerful new items.
Electromagnetic Gigaflux Reactivator is an odd-looking cloth hat. The Use ability on it has a 30 minute cooldown. The helmet possesses the ability to control lightning.
The Elemental Power Extractor is provided as an objective for Elemental Power Extraction.
Elemental Power will appear (after killing) when you use Elemental Power Extractor on a Sundered Rumbler or Warp Aberration in Netherstorm.

It is possible that the elementals of Azeroth have formed a hierarchy within their respective region of the Elemental Plane, explaining their ranks and titles. Powerful elemental beings have titles such as Baron, Lord, and Duke. The most powerful ones are known as elemental princes, and they are usually the offspring of the Elemental Lords. Lesser elementals are low-ranking among the elemental hierarchy.
Electra Stormsurge is an air elemental who works for . She seeks to gain as much power as possible from her ability to control lightning.

The Electric Wall is a magical barrier blocking the path to Skycallers' Spire in Vol'dun during Vengeance From Above. The player must tell Vorrik to destroy the barrier before they can land in the spire area.
Elemental Potion of Power is created with Dragon Isles Alchemy (25); taught by Recipe: Elemental Potion of Power.
Elemental Potion of Ultimate Power is created with Dragon Isles Alchemy (50); taught by Recipe: Elemental Potion of Ultimate Power.
Elixir of Firepower increases fire spell power by 10 for 1 hour.
__NOTOC__ Elixir of Ogre's Strength provides a bonus to strength for 1 hour
Elixir of Frost Power is crafted with Alchemy (190); taught by Recipe: Elixir of Frost Power.
Elixir of Empowerment is crafted with Outland Alchemy (65); taught by Recipe: Elixir of Empowerment.
Elixir of Major Frost Power is made with Alchemy (320); taught by Recipe: Elixir of Major Frost Power.

__NOTOC__ Elementium Ore is the hardest metal known to Azeroth, even moreso than diamond. Very rare and difficult to find and process, it is used in the creation of extremely powerful weapons and armor. With the rise of Deathwing and the second shattering, the Ore has become more common, especially in areas that have been affected greatly by his elemental servitors, such as the Twilight Highlands. As per War of the Scaleborn , Elementium is defined alongside Blacksteel as a "lightweight material", in contrast to the RPG Book sources.

Elementium Destroyer's Ring is created with Cataclysm Jewelcrafting (75); taught by Design: Elementium Destroyer's Ring. Materials are * 4x Elementium Bar * 4x Chimera's Eye (== 1 Jewel-crafting token) * 4x Demonseye * 75x Volatile Air

Elodor is a draenei city located to the northwest of Karabor, and is the breadbasket of . It is the home of the Council of Exarchs, the five draenei leaders under . The city is separated into sections, the main town, , Elodor Dig, Elodor Fields, Exarch's Rise, Fey Landing, Rangari Enclave and The Silken Pillow. During the course of the Draenor campaign, is murdered by Soulbinder Nyami under the order of Exarch Othaar. After much bickering, Othaar is exposed and flees to .

__NOTOC__ Ellias is a night elf quest giver and member of Hemet's Hunting Party found at Nesingwary's Retreat in Highmountain. He sends adventurers to hunt down the supposedly magical lion, Rashar, and later participates in the fight against Irewing at her nest in Pinerock Basin.

Elementalry! is an achievement earned by slaying a Well-Traveled Nether Elemental before defeating the Star Augur Etraeus encounter in the Nighthold instance on Normal difficulty or higher. To obtain this achievement, you will need the Nether Elemental add, which can be found in the Terrace Gardens near where Spellblade Aluriel patrols, with two Celestial Acolytes channeling it. After clearing a path from the add to Star Augur Etraeus, the Nether Elemental should be pulled (by first pulling the other adds) to the boss, and then beginning the encounter. As the different phases of the fight progress, the Nether Elemental will transform and gain increased health. When the final phase is reached

Elite Battlemages are blood elves and Forsaken located in the Underhold during Stay of Execution. They are controlling Inhibitor Crystals while being protected by a magical shield. Jaina Proudmoore destroyed the shields so that the adventurer could defeat them.
Elune's Grace was a defensive night elf-only priest ability. All such race-specific priest abilities have been removed.

Elwynn Forest, the Forest of Elwynn or simply Elwynn, is a vast woodland of stately hardwoods nestled just below the foothills of the Burning Steppes to the north. The idyllic Redridge Mountains lie to the east, and to the south, across the Nazferiti river is where Duskwood is located. It is the heartland of the human Kingdom of Stormwind and consequently is the starting point of all human characters. Marshal Dughan serves as the municipal law enforcer for Goldshire and Marshal McBride serves as the municipal law enforcer for Northshire Valley. Though much of the forest was burned down during the First War, trees and lush glades have grown anew. Stormwind City lies northwest of the forest an

__NOTOC__ Elrodan is a blood elf located in Silvermoon City's Sunfury Spire, in the same room as the mage trainers. A mage named Aurosalia is being repeatedly polymorphed by him into various different forms, and she begs to stop.

Elynara is blood elven warlock and the Horde's archaeology trainer based in the Reliquary in Silvermoon City, speaking with Doranir and Aelnara of the Reliquary. She also appears in the Ancestral Rise of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms and in Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit assisting the Reliquary in their work. Elynara accompanies the Sunreaver Onslaught on the Isle of Thunder. She is first seen aboard Salabria and later in Dawnseeker Promontory.

The Ember Ward is one of the seven district wards of Revendreth. It encompasses an area of mountains and deserts in western Revendreth, bordering the Military Ward to the north, the Castle Ward to the east, and the Forest Ward to the southeast. It is only accessible through an elevator in Sinfall, a path from Dominance Keep, a path from the Castle Ward, and a path from the Banewood. Eons ago, the area now called the Ember Ward belonged to Prince Renathal, along with Sire Denathrius's creations, the nathrezim. In those days, it was a place of dark magic and experimentation. After the nathrezim were discovered infiltrating other realms, the Light unleashed its wrath upon Revendreth, permanentl

The Embassy Guard is a human located in the Stormwind Embassy of Stormwind City. He only appears for dracthyr. It is actually Elling Trias in disguise, an SI:7 agent sent by Mathias Shaw to observe the drachtyr who have just arrived in the city.

in the Emerald Nightmare version of Un'Goro Crater.]] , the Nightmare Lord.]] The Emerald Nightmare (or the Nightmare for short) is the name given to the Old God corruption of the Emerald Dream. When the Nightmare spreads, it consumes the life force of all it touches. The more it spreads, the weaker druid magic becomes. It is a realm of death, decay, and nightmare. During the War Against the Nightmare, it was revealed that the Emerald Nightmare was under the rule of a figure known as the Nightmare Lord, who in fact was really Malfurion Stormrage's old nemesis Xavius. However, it was also revealed that Xavius himself was a minion of a powerful yet ancient evil, residing in the Rift of Aln, an

Emberwyrms are a type of skeleton dragon typically raised by the Scourge from the corpses of red dragons to serve as powerful minions, as seen in Heated Battle. They appear similar to the magmawyrms formerly of the black dragonflight. Nightbane in Karazhan may be a type of emberwyrm, although he was raised from the blue dragon Arcanagos.

The Embiggifier is a product of the Da'kani intellect and gnomish ingenuity that makes things big. It was masterminded by Morton Cogswald, Megs, and Grong, a Da'kani gorilla. It converts intelligence into size and strength. It is used to make Grong supernaturally big and strong for the Battle of Dazar'alor.

Emerald Shards are scattered throughout the Emerald Dreamway. These fragments of the emerald flight's power can be found next to Drained Emerald Drakes, who have been attacked by Void creatures. Each shard in your inventory grants a stack of the buff.
Empowered Leggings are cloth leggings that give bonuses to stamina, intellect, spirit, spell power and critical strike rating.

Empoor is a wandering Broken merchant and a quest giver located on the road between Shattrath City and Tuurem in Terokkar Forest. He is accompanied by his bodyguard. He occasionally delivers goods on commission. He delivered the parts supplied by Wind Trader Lathrai to blood elves in Tuurem that were used to build the mana bomb that destroyed the Cenarion Thicket.

Emissary Mordin is a level 63 elite human male located on the Terrace of Light of Shattrath City, near the flight master. As of Patch 2.4, he is involved in the following quests: * Gaining the Advantage .
Empowered Ametrine is created with Jewelcrafting (450) and a Simple Grinder; taught by Design: Empowered Ametrine.
The Empowered Rune was provided as an objective for Empowered Rune (quest).

Empowering Spirits are summoned by Thalnos the Soulrender to raise Fallen Crusaders as Empowered Zombies. Spirits spawn right next to Thalnos, so if the crusaders are near him as well, they will not be able to be killed in time.

The Emperor's Reach can be found on the north slope of the Peak of Serenity, overlooking Zouchin Province in northern Kun-Lai Summit. The reach is accessible only via flying mount or creative mountain climbing from the peak.

The Emperor's Step is the main entrance of the Shrine of Seven Stars, located in the center of the first floor. To the left is the Star's Bazaar, the Golden Lantern inn is to the right, the Path of Serenity is upstairs to the left, the Ethereal Corridor to the upstairs right, and the Summer Terrace is outside. The areas on both sides of the grand staircase are occupied: the southwest side has been converted to a small hospital, while the northeastern side is an engineering workshop. The southwestern balcony (accessible from second floor; Chamber of Enlightenment) holds examples of gear sets (helm and shoulders only). The northeastern balcony (accessible from second floor; Chamber of Reflecti
Empowered Spiritualist requires you to kill Thalnos the Soulrender while three Empowered Zombies are alive.
The Empty Moonwell Vial is provided as an objective for Nature and Nurture. When filled, it turns into Whisperwind Moonwell Water.
Empowered Moonkin was a druid Draenor Perk, available as early as level 92, though it was not guaranteed to be acquired until level 98.

Empowered Immolate is a Destruction warlock Draenor Perk, available as early as level 92, though it is not guaranteed to be acquired until level 98. As a hybrid spell, Immolate does damage both directly and through a damage-over-time effect. Empowered Immolate doubles the direct damage portion of the spell. This effect does not have any impact on the way you should play your warlock, it is just a simple damage increase.
Empowered Crystals drop from Drogbar Manathirsters and Violent Crageaters. They can also be looted from Siphoning Crystals in Highmountain.
Empower Wards is a level 103 Vengeance demon hunter ability.
Empowered Ambershard Crystals drops from Enraged Ambershards in Highmountain.
The Empowering Blood Orbs are found in the Crimson Hall of Icecrown Citadel. Using the orb provides the user with the Empowered Blood debuff which increases damage done by 100%.
Empowered Blood is a debuff that can be obtained from a Empowering Blood Orb in Icecrown Citadel.

Empty Energy Cells can be found throughout Mechagon Island. They are rewarded from several quests and also drop from most rares on the island. They can be charged into a regular Energy Cell by Charging Station.
Empowered Fel Crystals are fel crystals located in Mardum. Interacting with it provides the Empowering Fel buff.
Empowered Bravery is an anima power obtained from Broker Ve'nott and Broker Ve'ken in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Empowered Hops is an anima power obtained from Broker Ve'nott and Broker Ve'ken in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Empowered Release is a conduit for hunters. It drops from the following bosses: *The Lord Chamberlain in the Halls of Atonement *Sire Denathrius in Castle Nathria *The Prototype Pantheon in the Sepulcher of the First Ones *Valinor in Bastion *Mortanis in Maldraxxus *Oranomonos the Everbranching in Ardenweald *Nurgash Muckformed in Revendreth. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthening the Bond (Venthyr).
Empowered Chrysalis is a soulbind trait granted by Dreamweaver. It is exclusive with Soothing Voice and Social Butterfly.
To use an ability of the Enchanting profession to apply a permanent (but replaceable) buff to an item. See Trade for how to use this ability without trading an item.

The Enchanted Bridle is provided as an objective for The Black Knight's Orders. Take the bridle across to the east side of the camp and use it on the Black Knight's Gryphon to have it fly to the Black Knight's home, the northern edge of an island due north of Aldur'thar in the Frozen Sea.

The Enchanted Fey Dragon is an iridescent sprite entrusted with protecting the Emerald Dream, absorbing magic and exuding style. A mysterious and magical creature, it lives for excitement and has a zeal for adventure. True to its characteristic flair, the Enchanted Fey Dragon shifts its skin color on a whim, making big gatherings of these mystic beasts an awesome sight to behold. Saddle up on one of these and enjoy the instant street (and sky) cred that comes with being one of the last bastions of cool.

The Enchanted Lure is a bait item that can be fished up from open water in Suramar and from Runescale Koi Schools, with an increased chance to be caught when using an Arcane Lure. It is also sold by Sha'leth for . The lure will allow one to catch Magic-Eater Frogs, If this item is used after having obtained the Underlight Angler, one will instead be able to catch Magic-Eater Frogs.

The Engorged Blight Worm was a monstrosity created by Putress and his fellow Apothecaries in an attempt to stop King Varian from reaching the Apothecarium, Putress' Headquarters. Eventually, the worm is destroyed by Varian, Jaina, adventurers, and Varian's warriors during the Battle for the Undercity.

Engineer Palehoof is a tauren engineering trainer located on the lower rise in Thunder Bluff. He is responsible for keeping the city's elevators and windmills in good working order. Sitting nearby is Palehoof's Big Bag of Parts, which sells engineering supplies. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, he was trapped by the Void.
__NOTOC__ Endless Tincture of Fractional Power is created by Recipe: Endless Tincture of Fractional Power using Kul Tiran and Zandalari alchemy.
The Endmire Flyer Tether summons the Endmire Flyer, a devourer.

Enraged Foulwealds are a variety of Foulweald furbolg only seen during the quest King of the Foulweald. They will attack the player and try to destroy the banner until the banner or their leader Chief Murgut is destroyed. They usually attack in pairs and when one dies another will take its place.

Enrage effects are a type of temporary buff caused by various talents and abilities. Each Enrage has its own effects, and different Enrages do not stack. The exception is the Vengeance buff, which can be active at the same time as any other Enrage effect. Various mobs and bosses use enrage effects. Of the playable classes, all tanking specializations gain the Vengeance passive, which causes damage taken to produce the Vengeance enrage effect, increasing attack power. Aside from Vengeance, enrage effects are limited to Warriors and Guardian Druids in Bear Form. Fury warriors make the most use of Enrage effects, with Raging Blow requiring an Enraged state, Bloodthirst critting frequently, and

Enhanced Havoc is a Destruction warlock Draenor Perk, available as early as level 92, though it is not guaranteed to be acquired until level 98. As the Destruction warlock cleave ability, effective use of Havoc is also extremely important for success as a Destruction warlock. Enhanced Havoc further reduces Havoc's cooldown, allowing the ability to used even more often and thus deal even more additional damage.
Enraged Earth Shards can be found in Shadowmoon Valley. They appear after destroying an Enraged Earth Spirit.
Enraged Fathom Rays are fathom ray appearing at flight path points in Nazjatar when a member of the opposite faction attacks its flight master.

Enhanced Strength of Soul was a priest Draenor Perk, available as early as level 91, though it was not guaranteed to be acquired until level 99. It was replaced by Empowered Archangel partway through the beta.
Ensemble: Battlegear of Valor is sold by Barum in Darkmoon Island for .
Ensemble: Dreadmist Raiment is sold by Barum in Darkmoon Island for .
Entropic Embrace is a void elf racial ability. Abilities have a chance to activate it, causing it to grant a temporary buff that duplicates 5% of damage and healing dealt.
Ensemble: Wildheart Raiment is sold by Barum on Darkmoon Island for .
Ensemble: Magister's Regalia is sold by Barum in Darkmoon Island for .
Ensemble: Vestments of the Devout is sold by Barum in Darkmoon Island for .
Envoy Turom was an elite level 85 Twin Peaks battlemaster located in Silvermoon City during the Call to Arms: Twin Peaks. He was only available during the monthly (Call to Arms: Twin Peaks).

:For non-quest related information for the zone, see Old Hillsbrad Foothills. Escape from Durnholde Keep, aka The Escape from Durnholde Keep or simply The Escape from Durnholde, is the first instance within the Caverns of Time. This zone sends players back seven years in time to the Old Hillsbrad Foothills to preserve the flow of time. In the original timeline, Taretha Foxton set off a diversion that allowed the young Thrall to escape Durnholde and start his journey. Meddling agents of the mysterious infinite dragonflight, however, have kidnapped Taretha. Since she is unable to create a diversion, the bronze dragonflight asks players to do it themselves. Eredath, called the Jewel of Argus, was one of the most illustrious cities of Argus, the pinnacle of eredar civilization, and the most sacred of all cities. Following the destruction that befell Argus, the city of Eredath now floats above the planet, in a relatively pristine state. Eredath serves as one of three zones on Argus and hosts the Seat of the Triumvirate dungeon.

Erunak Stonespeaker is a powerful Broken shaman quest giver allied with the Earthen Ring. He is assigned to aid the Horde and Alliance in Vashj'ir against the naga allied with Deathwing and the Old Gods' forces. He is found in The Briny Cutter and The Immortal Coil of Kelp'thar Forest. He can later be found at Shallow's End, the Deepmist Grotto and next to the coil of rope for The Abyssal Ride in Kelp'thar Forest. In the Shimmering Expanse, Erunak makes an appearance inside Nespirah for the quest Nespirah. When he is captured by Ozumat in Defending the Rift, he is controlled by and later freed from Mindbender Ghur'sha by adventurers.

Erik then attacked Silas and Burth immediately went to protect his master but Silas stopped him. The brothers left threating the faire. Eunice Burch is a Forsaken cooking trainer located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity. She was present during the Battle for Lordaeron and could be evacuated out of the Undercity.
Ethenial Moonshadow is a wraith quest giver found in Moonrest Gardens in the Dragonblight.
Eternal Lunar Pears are found near they moonwell at Malfurion's Breach, after completing Filling the Moonwell.

Evelle Nightwhisper is a night elf quest giver located at Moonclaw Vale in Val'sharah. She is first encountered inside Moonclaw Cavern as a prisoner of Kagraxxis the Corruptor that's about to be sacrificed.
Eventide Apparel is a shop located in the Evermoon Commons of Suramar City in Suramar. It is run by Leyweaver Jorjana.
Ethereal Key is an anima power that did not make it to live servers. It was replaced by Imperfect Panacea, which was then replaced by Regenerative Fungus.

__NOTOC__ Eviscerate is a level 2 rogue finishing move. It's a simple instant damage ability that can be used to finish off monsters or take a big chunk out of them. Its damage depends your attack power and the number of combo points used. At level 22 Assassination rogues replace it with Envenom, while Outlaw rogues replace it with Dispatch.

Eversong Forest referred to the woodland stretching from the southern borders of Quel'Thalas, to the city of Silvermoon. It had trees with gold leaves. During the Second War, fully a third of the forest was burned down by red dragons enslaved by the Old Horde. Today, it is split between the Eversong Woods to the north, and the Ghostlands to the south.

An ex-paladin is a paladin or paladin warrior who ceases to be good, who willfully commits an evil act, or who grossly violates the paladin code of conduct. A paladin must be of good alignment and loses all light abilities if he ever willingly commits an evil act. He loses all paladin spells and abilities (but not weapon, armor, or shield proficiencies). Additionally, a paladin’s code requires that he respect legitimate authority, act with honor (not lying, not cheating, not using poison and so forth), help those in need (provided they do not use his help for evil or chaotic ends), and punish those who harm or threaten innocents. __NOTOC__ Exarch Larethor is a draenei quest giver found with an expedition of Shattered Sun Marksmen inside Magisters' Terrace. He was originally located at the Shattered Sun Staging Area on the Isle of Quel'Danas.

__NOTOC__ Exarch Nasuun is a draenei quest giver located in the Terrace of Light of Shattrath City once players have retaken the Sun's Reach Sanctum of the Isle of Quel'Danas. Much like retaking the Sanctum, players completing his daily quest will speed the process along.
Ewes are sheep found on the northeast side of the Lower City in Shattrath City. They are tended by Farmer Griffith. Worgen may also see them roaming around the Ruins of Gilneas.

__NOTOC__ Eversong Pink Elekks are see-through pink elekks found roaming near the gates to Silvermoon City in Eversong Woods during Brewfest. They can only be seen when you are drunk or wearing Synthebrew Goggles.

Exarch's Refuge is a small camp just outside , which serves as a staging area for the and Sunsworn forces against the seeking to take the holy tomb-city. Some Draenei Weapons have been left here for the commander's use. The location of this camp is at one of the defense pillars that the Auchenai soulpriests are attempting to maintain, until they get a power source.

The Evergrowth was a collective hivemind created when the Sporemounds of ancient Draenor tapped into the Spirit of Life, which ignited a crude communal sentience that allowed Draenor's plants to act as a single massive organism. If any major threat arose, the Evergrowth could react in unison, yet such threats were non-existent, for the Evergrowth dominated everything in sight, and nothing could hold it at bay. Most of it was initially destroyed by the giant Grond and his descendants, while many years later it was finally destroyed forever when the Apexis used the Breath of Rukhmar to incinerate the armies of the treant Gnarlgar.
Everwarm Socks is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned for mages. Gaining this power unlocks Creeping Freeze as an option from future anima caches.
__NOTOC__ .]] Execute is a level 10 warrior ability. It's a heavy-damage ability that can only be used on targets with less than 20% of their health left.

The Expedition Armory is the crumbled ruins of the Alliance Expedition's first base in Hellfire Peninsula. Twenty years ago, shortly after the Second War, humans and orcs fought a terrible battle on Hellfire. In the end, the human lines crumbled, and the Expedition Armory was destroyed by the orcs. Many humans fell, and death knights used their necromantic powers to raise the fallen soldiers into ghosts, known as the Unyielding. They now haunt the ruins of their former outpost. It contains several ruined buildings, including Nightwatch Inn, and Lordaeron Armory.
The Expedition Transport is a flying machine located at the Overspark Expedition Camp on Mechagon Island.

New World of Warcraft players automatically start in Exile's Reach before moving to their faction's capital and entering Battle for Azeroth leveling content. Existing players starting new characters are able to choose if they want to start in their race's regular starting zone or in Exile's Reach before moving on to 10-50 content. The story through the island culminates in a mini-dungeon of two bosses designed for 1 to 5 players, with scaling difficulty and no role requirements. The Exile's Reach storyline is the new-to-World of Warcraft starting experience for brand new players with no other characters on the account. The Horde and Alliance sent an expedition to Exile's Reach, but it was never heard from again. Novice adventurers travel to the island as part of a bigger and stronger expeditionary force to find out what happened. As with many such journeys, the adventurers find themselves as part of a crew aboard a ship bound to their last known location. Expeditionary Priests are dwarves found in Draco'dar, in the south-western corner of the Burning Steppes. They can be seen when riding a gryphon, for example, from Stormwind City to Ironforge, right after crossing the Elwynn Forest/Burning Steppes border. It is unknown what are they for, as they are not involved in any quests and offer no services. They are seen with Expeditionary Mountaineers and sometimes fighting Rogue Black Drakes and will also assist you with fighting them (if you are Alliance). It was confirmed by Horde players that they have no loot, as well as the dragons they are fighting.

Exploration achievements are awarded for exploring each zone in the game and all of its sub-zones for 10 achievement points per zone. Explore entire continents to get the meta-achievement for the continent and 25 points. Exploring Northrend also rewards the Tabard of the Explorer, sent in the mail from Brann Bronzebeard himself! Finally, explore the known worlds to receive the title and 50 achievement points with the achievement Universal Explorer. This category also includes a variety of miscellaneous achievements. In Outland and Northrend there are achievements for killing the named rare mob spawns, while Cataclysm includes Stood in the Fire, From Hell's Heart I Stab at Thee and Surveying
Explore Alterac Mountains is an exploration achievement earned for exploring the entire map of the Alterac Mountains zone. Required for the meta-achievement Eastern Kingdoms Explorer.
Explore Moonglade is an exploration achievement earned for exploring the entire map of the Moonglade zone. Required for the meta-achievement Kalimdor Explorer.
Explore Stonetalon Mountains is an exploration achievement earned for exploring the entire map of the Stonetalon Mountains zone. Required for the meta-achievement Kalimdor Explorer.
Explore Redridge Mountains is an exploration achievement earned for exploring the entire map of the Redridge Mountains zone. Required for the meta-achievement Eastern Kingdoms Explorer.
Explore Shadowmoon Valley is an exploration achievement earned for exploring the entire map of the Shadowmoon Valley zone. Required for the meta-achievement Outland Explorer.
Explore Highmountain is an exploration achievement earned for exploring the entire map of the Highmountain zone. Required for the meta-achievement Broken Isles Explorer.

The Experimental Buff Mine is a land mine located in a house in the Dwarven District of the Vision of Stormwind. To reach it, adventurers must avoid a great number of Tamper-Proof Teleportation Mines. Upstairs, an Engineer's Note will explain its use. Stepping on it will empower the user, increasing their damage dealt by 10% for the remainder of the vision.

World of Warcraft: Exploring Azeroth is a series of in-universe guidebooks exploring the various continents of Azeroth. They are presented as notes from various characters as they traverse the land. Presumably the collection is complete at 5 volumes. A box set that included a collectable cloth-style map and collectible pin titled World of Warcraft Exploring Azeroth: Complete Collection was released on December 31, 2024. __NOTOC__
Exploring Azeroth: Islands & Isles is an official Warcraft book by Alex Acks presenting information on Islands & Isles.

The Eye of Ysera, often just shortened to "the Eye", is a place within the Emerald Dream. It is the green dragonflight's main base where Ysera and her brood watches over both the dream and Azeroth from. It was founded shortly after Azeroth's (and thus also the Emerald Dream's) creation when the green dragonflight was charged with their task of protecting both realms. The other green dragons honored Ysera by naming the field and that created within the Eye of Ysera.

Eye of the Storm Emissaries were draenei Eye of the Storm recruiters located at various spots throughout the largest Alliance cities - Stormwind City, Exodar, Darnassus, and Ironforge, as well as the neutral Shattrath City during the monthly Call to Arms: Eye of the Storm.

The Eye of Azora is located in the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest. It is a magical scrying sphere that allows the user to see the Tower of Ilgalar and its surroundings. Theocritus uses it to keep an eye on his rival, Morganth. The Glyph of Azora should allow the eye to have expanded powers, if placed on the Old Lion Statue near to the Tower of Ilgalar, but even better if placed atop a tower of Stonewatch Keep.

The ExtraActionButton1 is a UI element that appears during certain boss fights and quests that gives the player access to special fight-specific or quest-specific powers. This UI element is mildly notorious because it is not handled properly by some UI replacement add-ons, robbing users of the ability, often with fatal results. The most common workaround is the following macro: /click ExtraActionButton1 although it is also possible to bind it to a key through the standard key bindings.

Eye Sentries are small floating eyeballs hiding in the Watcher's Sanctum of Throne of Thunder. A single sentry will appear after a Roaming Fog has been engaged. Their only ability is to forcefully pull five random players into a miniature version of Durumu's maze ability (without the disintegration beam), they can only be killed while inside the maze.

__NOTOC__ Eyes of Yazma are stealthed spiders located in Dazar'alor. They scout the city for Yazma. They were later used by Yazma to betray the city and attacked Zanchul. They can also be found at Nesingwary's Trek in Zuldazar.

The Extra Action Button is an added ability given to the player during an event, a quest, or a zone. A large icon appears at the bottom-middle of the screen and one can either click it or if possible, drag it into the action bar. These abilities are typically not permanent.
Extra Fancy Darkmoon Feast is crafted with Cooking (225); taught by Recipe: Extra Fancy Darkmoon Feast.

Facing describes a player or NPC's orientation in relationship to another unit, or simply a given direction. It is almost always phrased as a binary condition - a character is either facing the specified unit or direction, or it's "facing away", with 90° to either side of the unit's exact front acting as the cutoff. Being front-facing is another way to say the unit is facing what was specified. Facing is variously used to determine whether one unit can attack another, the effectiveness of spells or abilities, and the applicability of defensive statistics. The exact front of a player is the direction the player will go if they press their forward movement key (and no others). NPCs will almost
"Face Melt" is a reference to a Priest's shadow abilities, specifically: * Mind Blast * Mind Flay The term originates from the graphic for the Mind Flay ability, which resembles a face melting.

Faded Journal was a item found on hostile worgen in Gilneas City during the Worgen starting experience. Gaedrin Moonfang was the author, one of the first Druids of the Pack who had kept his night elf mind longer than most of his comrades.
Fae Empowerment is a passive Balance druid ability, available at level 72.
The Faded Portrait of Osep was to be obtained through the Blight Boar event on Darkmoon Island. It was replaced by Faded Portrait of Devlynn Styx.

Fae Guardians is the priest class ability of the Night Fae Covenant. It's available to all priests who join the Night Fae. This ability is also temporarily available during the Ardenweald portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest Preparing for the Winter Queen and lasts until you finish the Ardenweald storyline.

Fae Transfusion is the shaman class ability of the Night Fae Covenant. It's available to all shamans who join the Night Fae. This ability is also temporarily available during the Ardenweald portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest Preparing for the Winter Queen and lasts until you finish the Ardenweald storyline.
Fae Empowered Elixir is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Falconwing Square is an area located in the southeastern corner of the Ruins of Silvermoon and at the end of Dawning Lane in Eversong Woods. It contains an Inn and class trainers, as well as several profession trainers. It is the first place where new blood elf adventurers can learn professions. it also contains a few quests involving the Ruins of Silvermoon and killing the nearby wretched. Spymaster Thalodien comes from the Square.
Failed Experiments were oozelings located in the Undercity during the Battle for the Undercity.

Faelin Stomp is the monk class ability of the Night Fae Covenant. It's available to all monks who join the Night Fae. This ability is also temporarily available during the Ardenweald portion of the Shadowlands campaign. It is unlocked after the quest Preparing for the Winter Queen and lasts until completing the Ardenweald storyline.
__NOTOC__ Fantei is a Broken reagent vendor located at the Lower City market in Shattrath City.
A familiar spirit is a normal animal that gains new powers and becomes a magical beast when summoned to service by a mage.

Far Seers are ancient Orcs who represent the pinnacle of Shamanistic power. These powerful Shamans are counted amongst Thrall's closest advisors and are constantly in tune with the workings and maneuverings of the Horde. Far Seers are not only tied to the elements of the earth and sky, but are also adept at foretelling the future.

Fangraal is a Draenor ancient who assists the Alliance in battle in Ashran. First encountered as a Lifeless Protector, Fangraal must be empowered by gathering 3,000 Artifact Fragments for Anenga in Stormshield Stronghold. Once empowered, he will push toward the Horde base, attacking any hostile characters he encounters.
Fancy Darkmoon Feast is created by Cooking (225); taught by Recipe: Fancy Darkmoon Feast.

__NOTOC__ Fan'verg the Vicious is a night elf ghost located in the Terrace of the Moon in Tomb of Sargeras. Fan'verg is found in an upstairs balcony room that overlooks the platform where the Sisters of the Moon are.

Fallen Order is the monk class ability of the Venthyr Covenant. It's available to all monks who join the Venthyr. This ability is also temporarily available during the Revendreth portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Authority of Revendreth and lasts until you finish the Revendreth storyline.

Farseer Nobundo is a Broken shaman farseer. One of the most tragic heroes among the Broken of Outland, Nobundo was formerly a draenei vindicator but lost the ability to call upon the Light during the fall of Shattrath City and was deformed by the fel energies released. Shunned by his people, Nobundo took up the calling of the shaman while wandering the wilds of Outland, and introduced it to his people with the blessing of the wise Prophet Velen. He would accompany his people to Azeroth onboard the Exodar, and guide new draenei shaman as they began on their path. In the wake of the Cataclysm, Nobundo has lent his services to the Earthen Ring to help calm the raging elements of Azeroth.

Farseeing is a divination spell that grants sight of distant objects and far-off locations. Originally used by the clerics of the Brotherhood of Northshire to keep a clear perspective and see things in an all encompassing fashion, the spell was eventually transcribed to books, one of which ended up in Karazhan's library. Khadgar modified this spell in order to make his own spell that would give him a vision of the past. In other cultures, shaman far seers have the uncanny ability to perceive distant places and events through a form of spirit sight. This ability allows them to anticipate enemy movements and maintain the element of surprise for the horde's fighting forces.

Farwatcher's Glen is an Alliance town located southwest of Thal'darah Grove and Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon Mountains. While using night elf architecture, it features many different Alliance races, most prominently worgen. It holds flight paths to Thal'darah Overlook, Mirkfallon Post, Windshear Hold, and Nijel's Point. In addition to Alliance NPCs, a significant number of ravens can be found here.

__NOTOC__ Farseer Lopaa is a draenei shaman trainer located in the Silver Enclave in the mage city of Dalaran. She was present in the city when it relocated above Deadwind Pass but did not offer his training services as she had to remain alert for any danger to Dalaran's visitors.
Farmer Maya is a Highmountain tauren quest giver and member of the Rivermane tribe located at Earthmother's Bounty in Highmountain.
Fara Dawntrail is a Highmountain tauren produce vendor wandering around the upper level of Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
Fasho the Wary is a vision of a Highmountain tauren located in Highmountain. He appears upon interacting with the Ancient Spirit Drum.

The Faraway Pools are on one of the remote islands off the Ardenweald mainland, southeast of Tirna Scithe. Marasmius will send players here on occasion once they have unlocked Tier 3 of the transport network on his daily quest Go Beyond!. The island has been invaded by the Drust, and Marasmius wants them gone. After discovering the location on Go Beyond!, players can speak with Zaki at the Heart of the Forest to purchase the Damp Portalbello to travel here whenever they wish.
Fatal Flying Guillotine is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Fated Power: Chaotic Essence is one of the fated powers applied to a raid boss during a Fated Raid. It summons a Chaotic Essence throughout the which starts casting a which will do damage to all players if successul. However, once interacted, it becomes hostile and starts spawning Chaotic Motes for players to defeat. After 15 seconds, stacking for each mote killed, players gain a buff for 25 seconds that increases their damage, healing, and absorbs by 2%.

Fated Power: Creation Spark is one of the fated powers applied to a raid boss during a Fated Raid. It charges a random player that starts inflicting a small Cosmic damage every second for 30 seconds. Once removed, it sends three Creation Sparks to nearby locations where players can stand in to gain a buff that increases their haste by 30% (similar to Bloodlust and the likes) and increases the movement speed by 55%. If players fail to catch a creation spark, it explodes and inflicts Cosmic damage every two seconds for 20 seconds.
Feathermoon Sentinels are night elf Sentinels that guard Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

Feats of Strength achievements represent the player's various glories of Azeroth, and as such, they are very difficult — if not impossible — to earn. They are worth no points, and unlike normal achievements, unearned feats are not displayed in the achievements interface. Feats include obtaining rare mounts, special titles, and more. Some Feats of Strength can still be obtained, while others are no longer possible to get. Deprecated achievements (ones that can't be obtained and have been made obsolete due to changes in the game) can be found in the Legacy tab.
The Feather of the Moonspirit unlocks the Moonspirit appearance for the Fangs of Ashamane artifact.

__NOTOC__ Fathom's Edge is a small area on the ruined world of Telogrus Rift, representing one of the many suspended islands that make up the zone. Along with a large portion of Telogrus, Fathom's Edge is under the control of the recently-created void elves, though none venture beyond this area and survive. Fathom's Edge also serves as a location for the training of novice void elves, as well as further research into the Void itself. A portal connects Fathom's Edge to the main island of Telogrus a short distance away.
Feathermoon Archers are night elves located in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
Feathermoon Huntresses are night elves located in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
Feathermoon Elites are night elves briefly located in Dire Maul in Feralas.
The Feather is located on the table behind Griftah in the market of the Lower City in Shattrath City. It can be interacted with if the Talisman of True Treasure Tracking is worn.
Featherstones are magical stones found in the Deep Roads in Highmountain. Clicking it gives: *

Fel Intelligence is a passive ability of a Warlock's Felhunter minion. It provides a passive boost to maximum mana and mana regeneration to party and raid members within 100 yards of the demon. It is learnt automatically by the Felhunter at level 32.
Fel Devastation is a level 11 Vengeance demon hunter ability.
Fel Devastator are devastators located in the Deceiver's Scar in Krokuun.

Fel Commander Erixtol is the doomguard in charge of the Assault on Highmountain. After four invasion points of the Burning Legion have been push back he declares that the mortals will bow or burn. After liberating Thunder Totem Lasan Skyhorn leads adventurers on to Erixtol's Legion ship and as they rescue captives and plant explosives, Lasan and Fel Commander Erixtol engage in combat. Though victories Erixtol is prevented from killing Lasan by the intervention of Azeroth's heroes. Fel Commander Erixtol is ultimately slain, with his ship blowing up soon after in order to liberate Highmountain from the Legion's Assault.
Fel Destroyer Crossbow drops from Argosh the Destroyer at The Felblight in Tanaan Jungle.
Feledis' Axes is a shop found in the Bazaar of Silvermoon City. The owner, Feledis shares the building with Rahein, owner of Blades by Rahein.
Fel Orc Converts are fel orcs located in the Shattered Halls. They are found in a few trash packs and are summoned by Shattered Hand Legionnaires.
__NOTOC__ Felborn Revenants are undead tauren located at the Highmountain Burial Ground in Highmountain.

Felblaze Ingress is the location of a demonic gateway in northeastern Azsuna. The area is overseen by a hidden demon, Overseer Felorax, that can only be revealed by destroying his warding crystal. It is also a location of a small Illidari camp. This camp also has flight path, with a path going across the river to a small camp there.
Felborn Phantasms are tauren ghosts located at the Highmountain Burial Ground in Highmountain.

The Felhunter is the fourth demonic minion available to a warlock, summoned through the Summon Felhunter ability, available at level 30. Thanks to Shadow Bite's increased damage for every DoT on a target, the Felhunter is the pet of choice for Affliction warlocks when it comes to damage output. It deals melee damage and possesses several anti-caster abilities. It has the same amount of health as the Succubus; more than the Imp but less than the Voidwalker.

__NOTOC__ Felicia Gump is a human florist located in Fragrant Flowers, a flower shop at the end of the Canals in the Trade District across from Old Town in Stormwind City. She runs the shop with Bernard Gump, who sells the same selection of bouquets. In spite of her title, she sells no herbalism supplies. She was present among the concerned citizens when the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned infiltrated the city.

Felstone Field is located in northwestern Western Plaguelands. Originally, the area had been a life-sustaining farm, but it was overrun by the vile Scourge. In their quest to destroy the living, they placed a large cauldron in the middle of the field which constantly spewed disease-filled vapors into the air. The cauldron itself was protected by Cauldron Lord Bilemaw, Skeletal Sorcerers, Skeletal Flayers and Slavering Ghouls. A Scarlet Crusader party was also detected in Felstone and would destroy both players and Scourge with equal vengeance. Inside the house in the northeastern corner of the field was a friendly NPC, Janice Felstone, who offered a quest.

Felsoul Hold is the name of a base of operations of the Burning Legion in the southwestern region of Suramar. The demon Azoran was leading the operations there and planned to use the Legion ship stationed there, The Lightbreaker, to destroy Dalaran. A soul engine was used to power the ship. At one point, the Order of the Silver Hand sent here their troops to dispose of the giant infernals and felbats who attacked any who come near, and to collect the blood of the demons for their own use.
Felscarred Destroyer are eredar brutes located in the Shattered Fields in Krokuun.

Feralas (pronounced Fehr-AHL-ahs), unlike its barren neighbors to the north, south, and east, is a lush jungle. Both the Horde and Alliance lay claim to the area and have to contend with powerful local forces. These include the bloodthirsty Gordunni ogres who control a number of scattered ancient elven ruins, including the vast ruined city now known as Dire Maul. The ogres have desecrated and defiled much of Feralas, damaging the land with their taint. The Horde in particular is concerned with the unchecked expansion of the Gordunni and has put out a call for adventurers to aid the war effort against them. Feltotem is a village found on the Rockaway Coast in western Highmountain, serving as headquarters for the Feltotem tribe. The Lair of the Devout is inside. Navarrogg led an attack on Feltotem with adventurers to kill the corruptors creating fel totems. They also found Tugar Bloodtotem and a Fel Infused Worm. During Legion Assaults, the corrupted tribe imprisoned Highmountain tauren and Norgabbon of Stonedark, seeking to conscript them into their ranks.
